name: opencv
description: Analyze an image with OpenCV. ops: info (size, brightness, sharpness), edges (Canny), contours (bounding boxes), faces (Haar cascade), grayscale, resize. Input: {"op": "info", "path": "docs/assets/mascot.jpg", "options": {}}. Written images land in state/opencv/.

op.description: Operation to perform. Defaults to info.
